outcome: Radiological features of pneumonia in neonates
SARS-CoV-2 IgM and IgG in neonates
cohort: 29 pregnant women with COVID-19 infection who delivered between January 30 and March 10, 2020, and their 30 neonates
finding: COVID-19 infection or radiological features of pneumonia were observed in some, but not all, neonates born to women with COVID-19 infection, suggesting that intrauterine or intrapartum transmission is possible.
mod_finding: 27 out of 29 women with COVID-19 infection elected to have a cesarean section delivery.
